provenance: https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC305574/ Table I and Table II, and https://www.pnas.org/doi/10.1073/pnas.0401162101
source_type: Published experimental measurements and genetic screens; not this project's computational predictions
ddg_definition: Increase in mutant destabilization compared with wild type, kcal/mol; negative indicates a more stable variant in the 2000 p53 source
interpretation: G245S/N239Y approximately restored wild-type folding stability in these experimental conditions. R249S/H168R showed DNA-binding rescue despite little stability improvement versus R249S. Neither case is a novel rescue discovered here. R249S alone had no detectable binding in this assay; its null is not a numerical nM value.
unanswered: Y220C second-site rescue not established by these cited measurements; no prospective model validation was performed.
